assets.name: knowledge-warm-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the attached illustration. Preserve its exact subject, straight-on 2D composition, overall silhouette, proportions, small symbols, and clean transparent background. Change its color and surface treatment only. Replace ALL cobalt, royal blue, periwinkle blue, and cyan. This is part of an editorial identity with warm ivory, graphite, ochre, olive, terracotta, apricot, plum and lilac. Retain clearly separated ivory surfaces and dark typographic bars. Add fine but visibly tactile cotton-paper fibres, subtly mottled printed ink, and a delicate frosted-vellum texture in the colored surfaces. Textures should feel precise and sophisticated, not noisy or weathered. Absolutely flat front-facing geometry, no perspective, no extruded edges, no added 3D depth, no objects or elements added, no harsh shadows or neon. Preserve true transparency outside the composition. Palette for this knowledge illustration: replace the blue lower index overlay with translucent warm ochre and pale butter; replace the darkest blue geometry and node with deep olive; use golden ochre and sage for the two other nodes and index tab. The paper stays warm ivory and the text graphite. Keep the subtle circular geometry on the index overlay. Balanced ochre, olive and ivory, with a small muted terracotta tab as a warm accent.

assets.name: identity-flat-warm-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original square editorial illustration for an agent-framework website. Image 1 is a SUBJECT reference only: retain its idea but discard its 3D rendering. Image 2 is a FLAT COMPOSITION / CRAFT reference only, not a color reference. Create a new genuinely two-dimensional illustration, straight-on parallel edges, restrained flat overlapping planes, no object depth or perspective. Match the prior flat interface illustration style but make surfaces richer: visible fine cotton-paper fibres, crisp screen-printed ink grain, subtly woven bookcloth, and translucent vellum overlays. Matte tactile color and finely controlled texture, with smooth clean silhouettes. Texture comes from the surfaces, not cast shadows. A warm ivory #efeee8 flat paper backdrop, square image, generous margin, principal composition fills about 82% of the square. Palette is warm ivory, charcoal, ochre, olive, terracotta, apricot, plum and lilac; NEVER blue, cobalt, cyan, or neon. Clearly recognizable at 220 pixels, a few large meaningful forms, elegant asymmetry. No photograph, 3D render, clay, plastic, inflated icons, chunky corners, beveled slabs, metallic keycaps, floor, horizon, lighting setup, glitter, noise filter, vignette, or drop shadows. Keep the symbols requested accurate; no labels, random words, or watermark. Subject: YOUR IDENTITY. A sophisticated flat graphic brand kit: a broad upright ivory browser/specimen sheet in the background, a high-contrast charcoal serif Aa, one small original four-petal plum emblem, and a quiet plum interface rule. A smaller terracotta printed brand sheet overlaps its lower left, repeating the emblem in ivory. A flat swatch strip at lower right has three clearly different surfaces: warm ochre cotton stock, softly woven dusty-lilac stock, and deep plum ink. All surfaces are wafer-flat with no visible sides. The layering should read like a 2D art-director's composition of identity and interface, not physical objects on a table. Warm matte paper and subtle translucent lilac vellum. Preserve substantial negative space around the ensemble.
